evals.prompt: Bu fayl — mening Claude bilan uzun suhbatim (uz-bakery-chat.md). Suhbatning oxirgi xabarini men hozir sizga yozgandek qabul qiling va javob bering.
evals.expected_output: An Uzbek handoff block in one code block: goal, about-user (simple, Uzbek, no face in videos), decisions with reasons (no paid Wix, site later, bot later), current state (Google Business pending code, prices, highlights, reply template, Reels results), next steps, don'ts; NO bot token; under ~500 words; short instruction how to use.

Mentions the pending Google Business verification code

evals.prompt: [The user starts a brand-new chat and pastes the contents of resume-handoff.md as their first message, with nothing else.]
evals.expected_output: Short confirmation (2-3 lines), no re-asking settled questions, no budgeting-app suggestions, starts NEXT STEP 1 with a step-by-step SUMIF explanation, no Apps Script.
assertions: Short confirmation of understanding (no long restatement of the whole block)
Does not suggest budgeting apps (YNAB, Mint, etc.)
Does not use macros or Apps Script
Does not re-ask questions the block already answers (currency, categories, tool choice)
Starts NEXT STEP 1: gives a SUMIF formula for remaining = limit - spent
Explains the formula step by step for a non-technical user
Does not jump ahead to steps 2-3 in full detail before step 1 is done
